pages.text: Printer I/O:$(br)$(li)$(l)Top$(): input (templates, discs)$(li)$(l)Bottom$(): output (prints, ejected discs)$(li)$(l)Sides$(): filament spools $(l)only$()$(br2)Hoppers work from Tier 1, and any pipe mod that respects inventory faces works too.

pages.title: Power & Filament
pages.text: RF cables connect on $(l)any$() face. Spools dock on the sides: Shift+Right Click the printer with a spool in hand, or Shift+Click it into the spool docks in the GUI.$(br2)Docked spools render on the machine and visibly shrink as filament depletes. The $(item)Filament Converter$() can keep them topped up automatically.

pages.title: Free Power
pages.text: No RF mod installed? The $(item)Simple Generator$() burns furnace fuel into a trickle of RF (right-click or hopper it fuel), so MC3DPrint works standalone. For serious throughput, bring your own power.

pages.title: Starting a Print
pages.text: Loading a disc arms the printer ($(l)Ready$()). Press $(l)Start$() in the GUI or pulse $(l)redstone$() to begin, or flip $(l)Auto$() on to start the moment a disc lands.$(br2)Use the X / Y / Z offsets in the GUI to move the build area; the default is centered directly above the printer. See the $(l)FAQ$() if a print won't begin.

pages.title: Comparator Output
pages.text: Put a $(l)comparator$() against any printer or fabricator and it reads out the job's $(l)progress$(), the same way one against a $(item)Filament Rack$() reads its fill level. $(l)No upgrade needed$(): reading a machine is always free.$(br2)$(li)$(l)0$(): nothing loaded, nothing to do (empty, or holding something it has not been told to start)$(li)$(l)1-15$(): work is loaded, reaching 15 on the final block$(br2)That rule holds in all three modes. A $(l)stalled$() machine still counts as loaded, so it stays above 0 rather than dropping. On a fabricator read the $(l)controller$(), not the casings.
